artifacts.summary: Research on the superseded (engine-deletion) scope for skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md: dependency status, current byte breakdown, existing cycle-plan/build-dispatch/cycle-postflight script coverage, the not-yet-built AskUserQuestion/.decisions.json mechanism, and the test/lint surface coupled to SKILL.md's internal structure.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, a task description block can carry chronologically-stacked '=== ADDENDUM ===' / '=== REVISED ===' / '=== ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION FOLLOWS ===' sections where addenda at the TOP supersede an original description preserved at the BOTTOM for history. Always check for this pattern and state.json's own recorded `title` field (which tracks the current, superseded scope) before planning against the bottom-most text.

lint-postflight-boundary.sh locates a skill's postflight section via a generic heading heuristic (`### Stage [6-9]` / `### Stage 1[0-9]`) and silently SKIPs (not FAILs) when no match is found. Any skill rewrite that abandons numbered 'Stage N' headings for a differently-named structure (e.g. a 'move'-based loop) will cause this lint to stop enforcing the postflight boundary for that file without any visible failure. Check this lint's heuristic whenever renaming a skill's stage headings.

specs/PATH.md is a hand-maintained plan-of-record whose Progress/Chain-progress tables can lag real state.json/CHANGE_LOG.md completions by multiple task landings (observed: tasks 143 and 148 both completed and archived while PATH.md's own text still described 143 as 'next, unblocked'). Always cross-check PATH.md's dependency/blocking claims against state.json and CHANGE_LOG.md directly rather than trusting PATH.md's prose as current.
